summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing Spring Boot 3.0 actuator JSON serialization configuration (management.endpoints.jackson.isolated-object-mapper property). It does not semantically overlap with existing skills: Platform-Aware JSON Parser Selection (cross-platform parser routing), DataStream Sink Output (Flink streaming), or peer candidates (trailing slash matching, properties migrator, URL routing). The candidate addresses a specific actuator endpoint serialization strategy not covered by existing registry. Peer candidates are unrelated configuration concerns in different task families.
